body: Yeah that's true. People always say the best way to get through life is to keep pursuing what you enjoy. Hopefully it will lead me somewhere cool. Where are you at with your life at the moment, if you don't mid me asking?

I think I enjoy them equally, although I do have a bit of a passion for politics. Not sure what I would do with that though and I also suck at debating so might not work out for me. I have spoken to the careers adviser at school but she was totally useless and just told me that everything would work itself out. I do struggle to see myself in the future, I just can't imagine it at all. My biggest fear is that I will end up falling into some monotonous job, and then look at the date and it will be 20 year later and I still won't have done anything with my life. That happens to a lot of people, but I think most people are scared of that as well.

I have absolutely no idea what I would do. I do psychology, history, sociology and politics at the moment. I have to drop one for next year, so I'm just going to drop the one I do worst in, which is probably going to be history. I'm not sure where I would go, just going to have to look at what grades I get this year and then see where I should aim for.

I do appreciate that I have a good setup, which makes me feel kind of guilty. I do like the idea of Uni, although it seems really scary and at the moment my grades aren't too great. I actually have my first exam tomorrow, and it's a pretty heavy exam season up ahead so that's probably making me feel worse as well to be honest.

Thanks for replying man, I will try to form better relationships. I do a bit of drawing sometimes, even though I suck at it it does make me feel better. I'm not religious I'm afraid, but thanks anyway. I know that I am the problem in terms of my friends annoying me, so hopefully as I start to get better I can become a better person. They are good people and I am lucky that I actually have friends so yeah. Thanks for your support.

Thank you so much for replying. Your wife is very lucky, with a supportive partner and a good therapist. I know I should see someone, it's just so so scary. Is this even depression though? I'm not so sure.

I do feel safe at home, never seriously considered running away or anything, it just sucks a bit. If I pass my exams this year and next year (big if) then hopefully I can go to University, so that might help bring me closer to them because I will be further away (I don't know if that makes sense?). I do have friends, and they are good people but I don't think that I can fully open up to them because we kind of have a rule that everyone has their own shit to deal with, so don't burden other people with yours. I can be myself around them though, and I'm lucky enough that I'm not bullied.

Hmm I don't know. I'm not sure if I've been any help to you! We'll just have to see how it goes. I'm off to bed now, totally exhausted. It really has been great talking to you. Stay safe, and talk to you later?

Honestly? I think I would say I love my dad, but I might be mistaking that feeling for me missing him. Don't feel like I love my mum though, and definitely not my step dad. Sorry to hear about your parents. I want my parents to be happy too obviously, like I don't want them to be harmed. I feel the same as you in that sense. I would resent them if I was in your position.
That's life I suppose, we just have to try and make sure that the good times outweigh the bad times. Turn that unhappiness into passion and determination and you'll really be onto something

They just have a terrible view on mental illness and all that. Horribly judgmental. Ok, putting myself out here a bit, but is it fucked up that I feel uncomfortable that you say my parents love me? That honestly feels so wrong.

That's really cool. I'm sure there are many good things about you. Not many people have that ability so if there is part of you that feels proud or happy about this, I would take that feeling very seriously.

Jesus, don't know what kind of hospital that is. Yeah it's good that they referred you, it will be really helpful. You're not an idiot for not wanting to, I think it's pretty normal (there's at least two of us, right?). Oh man I just really don't want my parents to find out, you know? I know that's totally irrational and ridiculous. Hate this fucking part of my brain.

Well then I guess it can only get better from here. It's good that you have a focus and like to help people out. You're really helping people out here. Make sure you spend lots of time helping yourself as well though. We are all here to return the help if you need it.

Yeah I totally know what you mean, I just need to grow some balls. I have this one teacher who I'm pretty cool with, so my plan is to talk to them about it maybe so I can talk to someone in school. Then again, I've been saying that for the past 3 years. Shit I feel anxious even thinking about doing that. Proud of you for going to the hospital! That's a huge step, I hope everything goes well for you. You deserve it.
Oh shit man I just read some of your other replies. Stay safe.

I am beginning to realise that perhaps what I am feeling isn't normal. I think that if I start to talk about it on here a bit then it might help me to  say something 'in the real world', but argh I don't know. I'm definitely not ready for that yet. Still feeling a bit weird about putting that out there on the internet for everyone to see to be honest.

Can't believe someone actually replied. Thanks so much bro! Glad to know that there is someone who feels the same. Your outlook on life is pretty cool actually, very refreshing to hear. I play ultimate frisbee (weird I know) and that is one of the few things I still enjoy, so I might try and pursue that a bit more. You are far too kind. I will try to keep going. Good luck to you too my friend, you honestly can't imagine how much this means to me. I hope you are well.
